shots.text: When I came back, the workers had already carried me to the waste chamber.
shots.note: The waste chamber: a heap of dead ants.

shots.text: Ants don't bury their dead, they just throw them out.
shots.note: A worker hauls a body and tips it onto the pile.

shots.text: So I climbed out of a pile of bodies,
walked back into the colony, and nobody noticed.
And that's when I realized being invisible might be my greatest weapon.
shots.note: Close-up: the green glint in his eye.
